title: [17/10/2023] Process for making soft cheese
prompt: The diagram below shows how soft cheese is made. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.

frame.name: Introduction
paragraphs: The diagram illustrates the process of manufacturing soft cheese from milk and water.

frame.name: Overview
paragraphs: The process undergoes five stages, beginning with the initial mixing of water and milk, and concluding with the cooling of the final product at a specific temperature.

frame.name: Body 1
paragraphs: The process begins when water and milk are combined in a mixing chamber, where a mixture is formed. This mixture then enters the first cooling process, where it is maintained at 5 degrees Celsius for two hours. Following this, the mixture moves to the fermentation phase, where salt is added, and the mixture is heated to 37 degrees Celsius for a period of six hours.

frame.name: Body 2
paragraphs: In the latter stages of production, the mixture is heated to 100 degrees Celsius during an evaporation process that lasts eight hours, producing steam as a by-product. Finally, in the final cooling stage, the soft cheese is cooled to 5 degrees Celsius for eight hours, during which waste water is removed through a filtration system, resulting in the finished soft cheese product.
